paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : GPT-4o-mini

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the change in informativeness over discrete, equally spaced categories. The x-axis is unlabeled with numerical values ranging from 0 to 4, utilizing a linear scale with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis depicts "Informativeness", also on a linear scale, with values ranging approximately from 0.920 to 0.950 and a tick label interval of 0.010. There are two lines represented. The first line is blue with circular markers, dashed style, labeled "0-CoT". It starts at an approximate value of 0.955 on the y-axis at x = 0 and declines to around 0.915 by x = 4, with notable decreases from x = 1 to 4. The second line, labeled "CoRe", is orange with triangular markers, solid style. It follows a similar path, beginning near 0.955 on the y-axis at x = 0, also declining to approximately 0.915 by x = 4, showing a similar pattern of decline at each integer value. The lines intersect each other multiple times. A legend is given top right.
